# Helm Render Intents

**UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL.** Generated by `scripts/generate-helm-render-intents.mjs`; do not hand-edit. Regenerate with `npm run helm-render-intents`.

This is the bridge between the full helm-expt chain and the simpler ConfigHub model. A render intent is one reviewed base-variant path: chart, version, values profile, namespace, capability profile, source lock, package base, evidence lanes, lifecycle routes, and target prerequisites.

It is intentionally generated only for real base rows in the master matrix. Candidate and custom-discussion rows stay visible in the matrix, but they are not emitted as runnable render-intent configs yet.

## Model

Simple view:

```text
Component
  base variants: how Helm is rendered
  managed variants: how ConfigHub operates the rendered config
```

Full helm-expt view:

```text
chart/version
  recipe
    base variant
      render intent
        rendered revision
          package base
            ConfigHub Units
              managed variants
                promotions / targets / observations
```

## Files

- [`intents.csv`](./intents.csv) - one row per generated render intent.
- [`intents.json`](./intents.json) - all generated render intents in one object.
- [`intents/`](./intents/) - one YAML file per generated render intent.
- [`contract.md`](./contract.md) - what the generated object claims and refuses to claim.

## Regenerate

```sh
npm run helm-render-intents
npm run helm-render-intents:verify
```
